caption:
Averaging two averages is a trap.

20 students averaging 80 and 30 averaging 90 combine to (1600 + 2700)/50 = 86, not 85. The weighted average isn't on the reference sheet.

Send this to a friend who's studying for the SAT.
tiktok_caption: Averaging two averages is a trap. 20 at 80 + 30 at 90 = 86, not 85.

youtube.title: Weighted Average on the SAT: Why It's 86, Not 85
youtube.description: The weighted average formula isn't on the SAT reference sheet. Worked example: 20 students averaging 80 and 30 averaging 90 combine to an average of 86.
